scope: Model/editor Quality v3 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0116; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: ‘The door is open.’ and ‘The window is open too.’ are natural short adjective uses.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian consistently maps open to «باز/نبسته» and avoids switching to the verb sense.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Dialogue-dependent tasks are ordered after exposure, duplicate exact-sentence assessment is practice-only, and hidden-answer retrieval remains the strongest evidence.

distractorQuality.evidence: A key distractor contrasts the verb sense, directly testing lexical sense control.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Generic story metadata was replaced where needed by scene copy grounded in the canonical setting and turns.

difficultyFit.evidence: Learner output uses short familiar be statements with one adjective target.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Repeated exact target sentences may remain for practice, but only the strongest occurrence is scored; this reduces false mastery from repeated identical answers.

transferQuality.evidence: The second turn transfers the same adjective sense from door to window.

overallCoherence.evidence: Outcome, reference sense, dialogue and assessment stay aligned.

learnerExperience.evidence: Runtime ordering and answer tolerance were improved, but no real learner test is claimed.

limitations: No independent human or learner test has been performed.
Only the adjective sense of open meaning not closed is reviewed.
Audio prosody is not evaluated at this text stage.
Quality v3 remediation was model/editor reviewed; real learner evidence is still required before public-release readiness.
resolvedFindings: Imperative verb open is explicitly excluded from scored target use.
Final retrieval is hidden before attempt.
Quality v3: dialogue exposure, duplicate scoring, safe speech equivalence and grounded story copy rechecked after deterministic remediation.
